conventions.mesh: Array xyz axis order and velocity components p0=x,p1=y,p2=z follow the notebook sky-projection code. Compute p/density at each positive-density contributing vertex, then interpolate velocity. p is in (M_sun/h)(km/s); density is M_sun/h per cell.
conventions.coordinates: 1000 Mpc box, h=0.681, central observer at tutorial array index 128 on each axis. Equatorial xyz=(RA0 Dec0, RA90 Dec0, north). Use R100 comoving r in Mpc, 1000/256 Mpc per grid step.
conventions.offset: Default 0 exactly follows notebook sky-map convention. Offset -0.5 implements a cell-centred registration sensitivity, varying observer and targets together. Absolute grid convention beyond tutorial not independently calibrated.
conventions.frame: simulation reads n dot v. relative-to-grid-observer reads n dot [v(x)-v(center)] within each draw. Both use source directions and the explicitly conditional R100 growth/transfer map. Local-grid matter velocity is not a measured Solar CMB four-velocity.
conventions.observable: For a draw v(z=0), b = A diag[g(z)(1+v_corrected/c)/v_corrected] v_los with R98 A from four windows and the R100 linear WF Jacobian. Distance placement uses R100 CMB redshifts and background; DMO z=0 and linear redshift extrapolation remain model assumptions.
conventions.ensemble: For M unique posterior fields compute sample mean and centered 36x36 covariance with divisor M-1. This is uncertainty conditional on a survey-constrained reconstruction and estimated dynamics. It must not be added to the existing unconditional S_PV without a joint generative argument. Rank <=min(M-1,36); two draws allow a transfer pilot only.

local_commands_from_active_checkout: Install manticore-data==2.0.1 in the analysis environment if necessary (sdist identity above); projection additionally uses h5py and the active htt_base dependencies.

Repeat reduce with --frame relative-to-grid-observer and a fresh output filename; use --origin-offset -0.5 for registration sensitivity. Expand to remaining actual catalogue keys after the pilot; for each fetch the implementation preflights all HEAD sizes under an explicit byte ceiling, then streams one draw at a time. The tutorial shows about 336 MB per field, so the full 80-draw plan is about 27 GB; exact lengths come from the live catalogue.
return: Each manticore_local_NNN.h5 is accompanied by manticore_local_NNN.source.json (bucket, key, index, size, ETag, SHA-256). Rerun the same fetch; existing matching draws consume zero transfer allowance. A lone receipt recovers by refetching the pinned bytes. The immutable NPZ embeds canonical per-draw receipts, source hashes, solver hash, numeric geometry/projection identities, frame and origin. Evaluate effective posterior sample size and covariance eigendirections separately from cross-survey calibration and holdout genealogy.
